set version 21.4R3-S5.4
set system host-name ex-lab-access1
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 description "lab host 1"
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members LAB-USERS
set interfaces irb unit 10 family inet address 192.0.2.1/24
set vlans LAB-USERS vlan-id 10
set vlans LAB-USERS l3-interface irb.10
